about: Free or freemium web apps that do a job with no repo to clone. /toolbox-add logs them here; bin/build-catalog.sh turns this file into catalog/websites.md; library.py indexes them as kind 'website'. Never sign up, start a trial or enter a card for one without the user's yes.

fields.api: true when it has a usable API (say whether the API itself is free in limits)
fields.verified: YYYY-MM-DD and where the free claim was checked, or 'not checked'

sites.name: Photopea
sites.does: Photoshop-style image editor in the browser; opens PSD, XCF, Sketch, Figma exports
sites.limits: ads on the free tier

sites.name: Squoosh
sites.does: Compress and convert images (WebP, AVIF, MozJPEG) locally in the browser
sites.limits: one image at a time

sites.name: remove.bg
sites.does: Remove image backgrounds in one click
sites.limits: free downloads are low resolution; full resolution and the API cost credits
risks: uploads the image to a third party: not for client material under NDA

sites.name: Coolors
sites.does: Generate and test colour palettes, contrast checker, palette from image
sites.limits: saving palettes needs a free account

sites.name: Excalidraw
sites.does: Hand-drawn style whiteboard diagrams, exports PNG and SVG
sites.limits: live collaboration links are public to anyone holding them

sites.name: cobalt
sites.does: Download video or audio from social links (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X) with no ads
sites.limits: public instance rate-limits; some sites break without notice
risks: only download content you have the right to reuse

sites.name: PageSpeed Insights
sites.does: Google's Lighthouse performance, accessibility and SEO report for any URL
sites.limits: the PageSpeed API is free with a Google API key and a daily quota

sites.name: ray.so
sites.does: Turn a code snippet into a polished image for social posts and slides

sites.name: tldraw
sites.does: Infinite canvas whiteboard for wireframes and flow sketches
sites.limits: saving boards across devices needs a free account

sites.name: Tally
sites.does: Form builder with unlimited forms and responses on the free plan
sites.limits: branding and some integrations are paid
risks: collects respondent data: check the privacy terms before client use

sites.name: RealFaviconGenerator
sites.does: Generate every favicon and app-icon size plus the HTML tags from one image

sites.name: Haikei
sites.does: Generate SVG backgrounds, blobs, waves and gradients for websites
sites.limits: some generators are paid

sites.name: unDraw
sites.does: Open-licence SVG illustrations, recoloured to a brand colour on the page
sites.limits: licence bars redistributing the set as your own library

sites.name: iLovePDF
sites.does: Merge, split, compress, convert and sign PDFs in the browser
sites.limits: file size and daily task limits on the free tier
risks: uploads the document to a third party: not for contracts or client data

sites.name: TinyPNG
sites.does: Lossy compression for PNG, JPEG and WebP, batch of up to 20 images
sites.limits: the API gives 500 free compressions a month with a free key

sites.name: Mixpost
sites.does: Self-hosted social scheduler with calendar, media library, analytics; one-time license instead of a subscription
sites.limits: Lite (free, self-hosted) posts only to Facebook Pages, Mastodon and X; the API and MCP need Pro, $299 one-time
risks: the free tier does not post to Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube or TikTok

sites.name: Manus
sites.does: Autonomous AI agent that builds a full website or app from a prompt, including backend, database, analytics and SEO, not just front-end design; also does slides, images, music, video editing and browser automation.
sites.limits: Every agent action (browsing, running code, analyzing a file) spends metered credits; free tier is capped and restricted to the cheaper 'Lite' model tier.
sites.verified: not checked (manus.im/pricing is a JS-rendered page; three fetch methods via web_fetch.py all returned only nav chrome, no pricing figures in the actual fetched text)
risks: Sponsored post (#manuspartner #ad) — the creator was paid to feature it, weigh the enthusiasm accordingly

Third-party pricing trackers (not verified first-hand against manus.im itself) describe a free plan with 1,000 starter credits + 300/day refreshed on a 'Lite' model, and paid tiers from $20/mo for more credits and the full model — treat these figures as unverified secondhand until checked directly on the pricing page in a real browser
You don't own the resulting infrastructure the way you would building it yourself — migrating off Manus-generated backend/hosting later is a real cost, not a given

sites.name: Soro - SEO Autopilot & Content
sites.does: AI writes and auto-publishes daily SEO blog posts for a Shopify store (or WordPress via a separate plugin): finds keywords, matches brand voice, does internal linking, image generation and translation into 50 languages.
sites.limits: $39/month flat, no free tier found; only installs on Shopify or WordPress, not a generic API.
risks: No free tier.
Shopify/WordPress only - doesn't fit the user's Next.js/Vercel client sites without a WP or Shopify install first.

sites.name: Codiv (OpenJev)
sites.does: Hosted inference for OpenJev, a free open re-implementation of TypeSafe's Jev typed-decision API: send yes/no, choice or score questions and get a calibrated-confidence answer in milliseconds, schema-guaranteed (nothing is generated/parsed). Jev SDKs work unchanged by swapping the base URL.
sites.limits: 100M input tokens free per account while the public experiment runs, no card required; beyond that, pricing not yet published.
risks: Labelled a 'free public experiment' - the free allotment could end or shrink.
the user already has a local/offline equivalent (tinyjev) - check that first if the use case doesn't need a hosted endpoint.

sites.name: PhoText
sites.does: Click text inside an uploaded image or screenshot and retype it; AI matches font/color/style and repairs the background seamlessly. Also removes/adds text, identifies fonts, and translates text in images.
sites.limits: Basic edits free; "generous free trial quota" on advanced AI features before a paywall (exact cap not shown). Edited images auto-clear after 3 days (30 days if logged in).
risks: Uploads go to a third-party server for AI processing (not purely local).

sites.name: SoBrief
sites.does: AI-generated summaries of 26,000+ books, readable or listenable (audio narration) in under 10 minutes, with PDF/EPUB export.
sites.limits: Large free library; "Upgrade to Pro" and "Get Lifetime Access" gate extra features (exact free cap not shown on the page).

sites.name: Privnote
sites.does: Write a note, get a link; the note is encrypted in the browser and self-destructs after the recipient reads it once. Optional manual password and expiration window.
sites.limits: No account, no limits found; fully free.
risks: Third-party server holds the encrypted note until it's read - don't use for anything that needs zero third-party custody.

sites.name: Perchance
sites.does: Free text-to-image AI generator and a platform for building/running random generators; no login needed to use existing generators (an account is only needed to create and save your own).
sites.limits: No account required to generate; account only needed to author/save custom generators.
risks: Free/unlimited image generation with no real quality controls - treat output as draft-grade, not client-final.

sites.name: OmniSocials
sites.does: Unified social-media API/app: one account to schedule posts/stories/reels, manage a unified inbox (comments/DMs/mentions), and pull analytics across 11 platforms (12 channels, since LinkedIn splits profile + company page) - Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube (Shorts only), TikTok, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon, Google Business. Reddit/Snapchat/Telegram/Discord/Tumblr/WordPress/Whop are 'Soon'. Ships a public REST API and an official MCP server (hosted remote + local stdio npm package) with 48 tools.
sites.limits: 14-day free trial, then $10/month per workspace flat (billed annually; monthly a bit more), no feature gates and no separate free API/MCP tier - the API and MCP are the same paid plan.
risks: No permanent free tier - trial only.
Recurring per-workspace cost scales if the user wants client/agency workspaces separate from the user's podcast.

sites.name: Exa Websets
sites.does: Describe an ICP in plain English (e.g. 'AI founders in London who previously worked at DeepMind') and it searches the web, verifies every candidate against your conditions with AI agents, and returns a clean, exportable list of matching people, companies or papers.
sites.limits: Usage-based pricing: $0.025/request (low effort) up to $1.00/request (X-high); no permanent free tier for production use. Startup/education grants give up to $1,000 in free credits; a free trial exists to test the API.
risks: Per-request billing can add up fast on large list-building runs - cost-check before a big pull.

sites.name: Componentry
sites.does: Animated React components with editable source (liquid-glass carousels, particle typography, 3D stacks, WebGL effects), installed via `npx shadcn add @componentry/<name>` or an AI editor's MCP.
sites.limits: No pricing page or paywall found; appears fully free/open-source.

sites.name: Space UI
sites.does: Motion-and-interaction UI kit for Next.js/Base UI: liquid switches, morphing controls, shaders, sliders, gooey effects, plus creative tools (3D avatars, procedural sounds, emoji packs). Installed via shadcn CLI.
sites.limits: Free: 60+ primitives, 114+ components, 17+ templates, 61+ hooks. 'Get Pro'/'Get All-Access' gates more blocks/templates/updates - exact price not confirmed (pricing page didn't render; homepage evidence only).
sites.verified: 2026-10-04 spaceui.one (pricing subpage blocked, read from homepage)
risks: Pricing page would not render for a proper fetch - confirm actual Pro price before recommending a purchase.

sites.name: Skecher UI
sites.does: Open-source registry of motion-first React components (morphing navigation, gooey toolbars, liquid-glass surfaces, animated text, AI chat UI), installed and owned outright via the shadcn CLI.
sites.limits: No pricing page exists on the site (a /pricing URL 404s); appears entirely free and open source.

sites.name: Planes
sites.does: 100+ interactive React/Tailwind/Motion components (physical knobs, split-flap boards, ferrofluid, command palettes, etc.) built with MCP and llms.txt support so Claude/Cursor/ChatGPT can discover and install them directly.
sites.limits: No free tier found - one-time $99 (launch price, rising to $199 after Oct 15, 2026) for lifetime access to everything, no subscription.
risks: No free tier - it's a straight one-time purchase.
Launch-price window: price roughly doubles after Oct 15, 2026 per the site's own copy.

sites.name: Arc UI
sites.does: 148 animated React components and 86 complete page blocks (dashboards, settings, auth, onboarding flows) with real interaction behavior, installed as editable source via the shadcn CLI.
sites.limits: Free tier covers most of the 148 components/86 blocks; Pro is a one-time $129 lifetime purchase for extra Pro-tagged components, templates, MCP/agent-skills toolkit and priority support.

sites.name: Unicorn Studio
sites.does: No-code, layer-based builder for WebGL shader/visual effects on a website - copy an existing design or build your own in the browser, then embed it.
sites.limits: Free: all 75+ effects, up to 8 publishes but with a Unicorn Studio logo, 720p/30fps video export. Legend ($14/mo billed yearly, or $20/mo monthly): unlimited publishes with no logo, commercial license, 200 AI credits/mo, higher-quality export.
risks: Free tier output carries a visible logo and isn't commercially licensed - don't ship free-tier exports on client work.

sites.name: 21st.dev
sites.does: Open-source registry/marketplace of React + Tailwind UI components, templates and shadcn themes (heroes, scroll effects, backgrounds). Copy a component's prompt straight into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar, or install via the shadcn/21st CLI.
sites.limits: Browsing and copying prompts/installing components appears free; a Pricing page exists but its plan details didn't render on this fetch - treat any paid tier as unconfirmed, not absent.
risks: Paid-tier details unconfirmed - re-check 21st.dev/pricing before assuming anything beyond browsing is free.

sites.name: Jitter
sites.does: Browser-based motion-design editor: drag animation presets onto layers (text, shapes, icons), import from Figma, export to video/GIF/Lottie up to 4K.
sites.limits: Free: unlimited drafts, 3 workspace files, 720p/30fps export, limited AI credits. Paid Pro/Max/Ultra tiers raise file limits, export quality (up to 4K/120fps) and AI credits; per-editor monthly price not shown on this fetch.

sites.name: animos
sites.does: Browser-based motion-template tool for design showcases: pick from ~25 looping animation templates, drop in an image or video, export MP4/WebM from 720p up to 8K in multiple aspect ratios (16:9, 1:1, 9:16).
sites.limits: Marked 'beta'; 'Try it Free' is the only CTA found, no priced plan table rendered on this fetch - treat as free-for-now rather than confirmed-permanent-free.
sites.verified: 2026-10-04 animos.app (no pricing table found on this fetch)
risks: Beta product - free access could change; no pricing page was found to confirm limits.

sites.name: OKSURF Google News API
sites.does: Free REST API returning today's Google News headlines (with article image, title, link, source) per section (US, World, Business, Technology, Entertainment, Sports, Science, Health).
sites.limits: No account/signup, no documented request limiting.

sites.name: QuickChart
sites.does: Turns a Chart.js config (as URL query params or POST body) into a rendered chart/QR-code image - embed directly in an tag for emails, reports or dashboards. Open source (self-hostable) with SDKs in 8+ languages.
sites.limits: Public hosted endpoint is free with no key for normal use; paid hosted plans exist for high-volume/commercial use, and it's open source if the user wants to self-host instead.

sites.name: IPLocate
sites.does: IP geolocation API (country/city/region/timezone/ASN/etc.) that also flags proxy, VPN, Tor and hosting-provider traffic - useful for enriching lead-form submissions or flagging suspicious visitors.
sites.limits: 1,000 requests/day free forever, no credit card, same data/accuracy as paid. Paid: one-time credit packs or monthly quotas (300,000 requests/mo tier shown, custom above that).
